section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Which city is designated as the greenfield legislative capital of Andhra Pradesh, built in the Guntur region on the banks of the Krishna?
explanation: Amaravati, near Vijayawada/Guntur on the Krishna, is AP's planned legislative capital. Visakhapatnam and Kurnool have featured in the three-capital debate as executive and judicial capitals respectively.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Prakasam Barrage, an important irrigation structure of Andhra Pradesh, is built across which river?
explanation: The Prakasam Barrage at Vijayawada spans the Krishna river. The Godavari's major structure is the Dowleswaram (Sir Arthur Cotton) Barrage near Rajahmundry.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Which classical dance form, characterised by fast footwork and expressive storytelling, originated in Kuchipudi village in the Krishna district of Andhra Pradesh?
explanation: Kuchipudi, from Kuchipudi village in the Krishna district, is the classical dance of the Telugu land. Kathakali/Mohiniyattam are from Kerala and Bharatanatyam from Tamil Nadu.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal border Andhra Pradesh. The state has the second-longest coastline among Indian states, popularly known as the:
explanation: AP's coast is part of the Coromandel Coast on the Bay of Bengal (eastern seaboard). Konkan and Malabar are on the western coast (Arabian Sea).

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The Satavahana dynasty, which ruled much of the Deccan and Andhra region, had one of its important capitals at:
explanation: The Satavahanas ruled from centres including Amaravati/Dharanikota and Pratishthana (Paithan). Hampi was Vijayanagara's capital, Warangal the Kakatiyas', and Kanchipuram the Pallavas'.

section: General Knowledge & CA · Ch6 — Andhra Pradesh Static GK
subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: The present state of Andhra Pradesh, following bifurcation with the creation of Telangana, came into being on:
explanation: Telangana was carved out and residuary Andhra Pradesh reorganised on 2 June 2014. 1 Oct 1953 marks the first Andhra State (from Madras); 1 Nov 1956 the merger forming united Andhra Pradesh under the States Reorganisation Act.
